verdict: Meta is delivering leads efficiently; Google Search has produced zero returns.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 31 leads at an average cost of $120.63 per lead, all of them from Meta — and Meta's efficiency is improving, with leads up 37.5% week-over-week while spend held nearly flat. Google Ads, by contrast, spent $2,108.37 over the same period and produced zero confirmed leads; that budget is being reviewed now for reallocation. Separately, 104 new opportunities are logged in your pipeline over this period, but none have converted to booked consultations, which points to a gap in the intake process rather than an ads issue — that is being surfaced and addressed. Next period, you should see a sharper lead-to-consult rate as the intake flow is tightened, and Google spend will not continue at its current pace without conversion evidence.
